# w.scrpt 0.1.0 RC27 checkpoint

Date: 2026-07-28

Worktree: `/path/to/wscrpt`

## Scope

RC27 adds a bounded read-only Git HEAD detail view so the editor can inspect the current commit's metadata, stat, and patch without leaving the streamlined IDE surface.

- `Esc v h` opens Git HEAD.
- `:head`, `:git-head`, `:show-head`, and `:head-commit` open the same view.
- The view shows repository path and the current HEAD commit details from `git show`.
- A repository on an unborn branch opens as a clear "no HEAD commit yet" view instead of surfacing a fatal log/show error.
- The view is read-only and cannot edit source text.
- The command runs `git show --no-color --stat --patch --no-ext-diff --decorate=short --date=short HEAD` directly through the existing bounded Git runner, never through a shell.
- It does not stage, commit, switch, pull, push, reset, tag, or discard working-tree content.
- The keymap reference, action footer, README, and iPad QA matrix expose the new HEAD route.

## Proof boundary

This checkpoint is locally verified on the host Rust/PTY path. It is not a real iPad Magic Keyboard, Blink Shell, mosh, SSH, tmux, clipboard, touch, reconnect, or real language-server proof. Those remain manual QA gates in `docs/IPAD_BLINK_QA.md`.
